title: puccinellia paupercula
intro: Puccinellia paupercula, commonly known as Pauper's Fescue, is a type of grass-like plant native to the Arctic and alpine regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Puccinellia paupercula include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant may include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being.
